review_type: Repository-owner-commissioned AI-assisted Econometrica numerical-methods advisory review
recommendation: Reject in the present form and do not invite another ordinary revision of the cumulative manuscript. A new, sharply focused paper on action-contrast-certified, incumbent-preserving policy iteration could merit evaluation if the general certificate is executed in a substantive nonlinear economy, its computational cost is characterized, and actual policy cost becomes the primary numerical endpoint.
blocking_findings: The action-contrast theorem and coupled-residual certificate are representation-neutral and do not establish a neural-specific computational advantage.
The economic ablation validates a hand-constructed exact action-null identity rather than executing the general positive, state-dependent coupled-residual certificate.
R52 creates no new independent expected-cost estimand and leaves intact the adverse R49 and R51 actual-policy rankings.
The time, memory and approximation complexity of constructing pair-state residual and action-kernel contrast certificates is not characterized.
The continuous investment benchmark executes only a final-date ablation, not the full finite-sweep near-optimality algorithm.
The exact null component is known algebraically; discovery, approximate nullity and misspecification are not studied.
No improved common complete-work-to-actual-policy-cost frontier is established.
The dimensional bottleneck remains tensor-cover dependent in dimensions two through four, and the new study is two-dimensional.
The economic examples are normalized and the new robustness result changes neither policy cost nor a calibrated economic decision.
The cumulative NBO platform scope remains disproportionate to the focused certification theorem and evidence actually established.
positive_findings: R52 is a complete canonical review-ready submission with ordinary sources, compiled documents, source-bound evidence and an independent clean rebuild.
The action-contrast safety and finite-sweep accuracy theorem appears internally coherent under its stated assumptions.
The coupled-residual recursion gives a legitimate constructive route that does not assume access to the unknown true policy value.
The original investment model contains an exact nonconstant action-null ReLU component with arbitrarily large global width.
The exhaustive eight-policy, 524,288-cell ablation verifies amplitude-invariant contrast-aware policies with no unsafe accepted action or feasibility violation.
The paper clearly separates deterministic theorem, regression tests, robustness ablation and inherited finite-sample cost evidence.
Adverse actual-cost rankings, failures, tensor scaling limits and numerical corrections are preserved rather than suppressed.
Publication provenance and auditability are exceptionally strong.

limitations: The reviewer did not retrain, resimulate, recompile or retime the scientific services; new executions would create new observations.
The reviewer replayed all frozen cell records and spot-checked the central theorem identities, but did not independently re-prove every inherited result.
Historical clocks are single-runner descriptive observations and support no hardware-general inference.
No claim is made that FVI dominates outside the declared investment studies.
This advisory review is not an Econometric Society editorial decision.
